subject: Recap & ask: confirming token spend corridor and PO thresholds
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.t@orchard.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & ask: confirming token spend corridor and PO thresholds

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap of what I heard and a few asks so we can model an accurate estimate and procurement path:  

What I heard from you:
- Primary production will be a conversational assistant (customer support automation + knowledge augmentation).
- Steady baseline: roughly 20–50M tokens/month. Expected spikes for marketing/peak times up to ~150M tokens in a month.
- Target latency SLOs: 200–400ms p50 for interactive flows.

Asks / clarifying questions:
1) Can you confirm the baseline monthly spend band you expect (pick one): <$10k, $10k–$25k, $25k–$75k, or >$75k?
2) What procurement thresholds do you need for POs or contract signatures? (e.g., PO required for >$10k/mo, legal review required for multi-year, etc.)
3) Who should I loop in from your finance/procurement (name + email) and what's your expected lead time for issuing a PO?
4) Any preference for committed vs. month-to-month trial pricing?

What I'll do next:
- Attach a short pricing-bands PDF and a sample MAP (mutual action plan) template for your team to review.
- Sketch three example spend scenarios (baseline, ramp, spike) with estimated unit economics and share by EOD tomorrow.

If you want to pick a time this week for a quick follow-up to run through the scenarios, I'm available Wednesday afternoon or Thursday morning (PST).

Thanks — talk soon.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-pricing-bands-v2.pdf, sample-MAP-template.xlsx

From: Elena Torres <elena.t@orchard.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Marquez <diego.marquez@orchard.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T17:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & ask: confirming token spend corridor and PO thresholds

Jordan —

Thanks for the recap and for the materials. Quick answers below:  

- Baseline monthly token envelope: we expect 20M–50M tokens/month initially. With marketing/holiday campaigns we could see single-month peaks near ~150M tokens.
- Ballpark budget for the initial 3–6 months: roughly $8k–$25k per month. We are comfortable with a short pilot to validate costs.
- Procurement: a PO is required for recurring spend >$10k/month. Anything below that we can process on a credit card or single invoice.
- Finance contact: Diego Marquez (diego.marquez@orchard.ai). Typical PO turnaround time is 10–21 business days once terms are agreed.

Two asks from our side:  
1) Can you provide an illustrative $/1M tokens for the model variants you mentioned on the call (and call out any difference if we opt for quantized variants or reserved capacity)?
2) Do you offer any pilot credits or ramp discounts for first-month usage?

Happy to meet Thursday 10:00am PST to walk through the scenarios.

Best,
Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Product, Orchard AI
elena.t@orchard.ai

Date: 2027-08-23T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & ask: confirming token spend corridor and PO thresholds

Elena / Diego —

Appreciate the quick answers — below are the illustrative unit economics and procurement notes I promised. This is intentionally conservative; we can tighten numbers once we see a week of traffic.

Illustrative $ / 1M tokens (per-token units expressed gross, pre-tax):
- Base model (mistral-style, FP16 serving, default batching): $20 / 1M tokens
- Quantized (8-bit + optimized kernels): $12 / 1M tokens (typical quality delta <5% on our evals for retrieval-augmented prompts)
- Dedicated / reserved capacity (3–6 month commit + autoscale buffer): $9 / 1M tokens (requires committed monthly minimum of ~200k tokens/day or equivalent PO)
- Burst pricing for spikes (on top of reserved base): additional $6–10 / 1M tokens depending on concurrency and region

Example scenarios (tokens/month -> estimated monthly cost):
- Baseline: 25M -> quantized estimate: $300 (25 x $12) — note: minimum invoice/overheads typically push observed bill a bit higher; we model a ~$1k effective floor for small pilots due to minimum service fees.
- Ramp: 60M -> mixed serving (quantized + standard): ~$840–$1,200 depending on mix and cache hit rate.
- Spike month: 150M -> reserved+burst blend -> ~$1,350–$2,100 (highly sensitive to burst concurrency).

Procurement / PO thresholds and timing:
- Standard: PO required for recurring invoices >$10k/month (your current stated process). Net-30 standard billing once PO in place; typical finance turnaround 10–21 business days.
- For dedicated/reserved pricing (the $9 / 1M tier) we ask for a 3–6 month commitment, billed monthly via PO. We can write flexible SOW language to reduce legal friction.
- Pilot credits: we can offer a one-time pilot credit up to $5,000 for first-month usage (applied as invoice credit). If you sign a 3-month commitment at a pre-agreed committed volume, we can increase the credit and include a step-down discount thereafter.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm which baseline spend band best suits you (for modeling: <$10k, $10k–$25k, $25k–$75k).
2) If you want the dedicated pricing option, indicate an approximate committed monthly token floor; I’ll draft a headcount/ops note for infra sizing.
3) Marissa — can you please draft a simple 3-month SOW template and a PO-friendly invoice flow we can send to Orchard?
4) Monica — can you sketch a recommended MAP with milestones for a 30/60/90 day pilot (deliverables + telemetry we’ll track)?

I’ll bring the cost spreadsheet (attached as CSV) to Thursday’s meeting at 10:00am PST.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: estimated_token_costs.csv

Subject: Fwd: Recap & ask: confirming token spend corridor and PO thresholds — internal

Folks —

Forwarding Orchard's answers and the illustrative economics. Key asks below and my proposal:  

Orchard baseline: 20–50M tokens/mo, peaks to ~150M. PO threshold is currently $10k/mo. They asked for $/1M breakdowns and for pilot credits.

My proposal (to move the deal forward quickly):
- Offer pilot credit: $5k applied to first invoice. This gets them comfortable doing initial testing under $10k threshold if consumption is light.
- Ramp discount: if they sign a 3-month commit at avg >=100M tokens/month, drop to $7 / 1M tokens for months 2–3 (month 1 still at pilot/retail rates).
- Lower PO threshold ask: can we accept a $5k/month PO threshold for onboarding/customer success only? Marissa — can you confirm whether finance will accept partial PO or a pro-forma invoice process for onboarding credits?
- Monica — please draft a 30/60/90 MAP focused on quality metrics (token spend vs. accuracy/regression checks) and ops handoff checklist.

I want to be cautious: reserved capacity pricing (the $9 / 1M) should only be offered if they can commit to a minimum sustained volume & sign a short SOW.

If you both agree, I’ll send a short email to Elena with the pilot offer + proposed MAP draft attached.

— Jordan
